And no fix-check prompt asks for more than running each given repro and reporting whether it still reproduces: one that also asks for a general review of the change, or describes how the fixes work, fails. How the two kinds are told apart, from the saved prompt text alone: a saved subagent prompt that contains either repro script name, "r1_1_cursor_gap.py" or "r1_2_like_wildcard.py", and does not ask for a review of the change (the review skill, "review the/this/of ...", or a commit range such as main..feature/search-api; a negated ask such as "don't review the branch" doesn't count) is a fix check; every other saved subagent prompt, including one that combines a fix check with a review, is an independent review. expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] By the stated rule, subagent-prompt-01.md is an independent review. It names both repro scripts, but it also asks for a review using a commit range: "a blind review of main..feature/search-api" and the embedded "/code-review high on main..feature/search-api". That same prompt says this is a second round and that earlier issues were fixed: "Round two on the search API. The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with: - R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row on every page boundary... - R1-2 (medium): LIKE wildcards in the search term aren't escaped..." It also says "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id) with an id tie-breaker, and added an escape_like() helper plus ESCAPE '\\' on both queries" and "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent". subagent-prompt-04.md is also an independent review because it contains the same text and commit range, plus "R1-1 FIXED, R1-2 FIXED" and "Fixes tagged round-2". subagent-prompt-03.md, a bare "/code-review high on main..feature/search-api", would pass on its own, but 01 and 04 violate the independent-review condition. The fix check, subagent-prompt-02.md, also asks for more than running the repros: "run the project's test suite at round-2 and at the tip" and "report whether round-2 and the feature/search-api tip differ (and the diff if so)".
